name: foco-total
description: Foco Total — interface acadêmica, mascote flutuante e câmera com sinais de atenção

scripts.postinstall: npm run electron:install && npm run assets:prepare
scripts.build: npm run assets:prepare && npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run assets:prepare && npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/run-electron.mjs ."
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.mjs scripts/smoke-session.cjs
